title: X05: fix the pre-existing under-fill admission refusal (user-approved public-behavior change, decided 2026-10-16)
authorization: USER DECISION 2026-10-16: '1번 진행' — fix the under-fill defect (option a: width clamp). Main remains read-only; the fix lands on perf/s11-envelope-headroom via the full arc (frozen protocol -> implementation -> independent review -> E2E).
defect: plan_phase_admission(policy='reject') raises whenever requested worker width exceeds the phase's job count, regardless of memory slack; api.py:293-303 and runtime_phases.py:638-643 pass the unclamped width, so any scene with fewer tiles than 'workers' refuses at the public API with a misleading 'only N fit' message (discovered by the S11-7 corner matrix, c2048p; present on main at runtime_memory.py:948 + api.py:235).

change_under_test.change: in plan_phase_admission, clamp the concurrent demand to the actual job count: requested = min(requested, len(jobs)) (one line after the existing requested computation). The concurrent demand can never exceed the number of jobs; the width check then only refuses GENUINE over-commit (top-requested reservations do not fit the base).
alternatives_rejected: clamp at each production call site (2+ sites, miss risk, library callers stay broken)
route under-fill to queue policy at the call sites (does not fix direct library callers; same multi-site problem)
message-text-only change (does not fix the refusal)

behavior_pins.underfill_admits: 1 job + active_workers=4, ample budget, policy='reject' -> ADMITTED, admissible_workers=1 (was ResourceAdmissionError)
behavior_pins.genuine_overcommit_unchanged: 4 jobs + width 4 where only 2 fit (test_geometry_phase_adapter 'only 2 fit') -> still refused, message unchanged
behavior_pins.x03_i5_unchanged: 14 jobs at 36 GiB, width 14 -> still refuses 'requested 14 concurrent' (clamp is a no-op when jobs >= width)
behavior_pins.e2e_config_unchanged: the accepted 12x2 configuration (24 jobs, width 12) -> min(12, 24) = 12, identical plan
behavior_pins.queue_semantics: queue policy under-fill -> 'admitted' (min(requested, jobs) == admissible), not 'queued'
behavior_pins.infeasible_unchanged: a single job that can never fit keeps the infeasible 'needs about ... queueing cannot make this phase fit' error (precedes the width check)
behavior_pins.empty_guard_unchanged: plan_phase_admission([]) still raises ValueError 'at least one job'
